name: Stylized Christmas Asset Pack (WillowBoxArt)
summary: 42 stylized Christmas 3D models (40 unique + 2 color variants): Santa, elf, snowman, reindeer, gingerbread man, decorated tree, sleigh, Christmas train with modular track, gifts, wreath, ornaments and props. One shared material and a 512x512 gradient atlas (~293k triangles total). Free FBX pack plus a ready-to-import Unity 6 package (Built-in RP). No rigs or animations. Page states no generative AI was used.

access.license: WillowBoxArt license (LICENSE file in pack; summary on itch page)
access.notes: Personal and commercial use; credit to WillowBoxArt required. No resale, redistribution, repackaging or re-upload of the original assets. Blender/Maya source scenes are Patreon-only (paid).

procedure: Open the itch.io page and click Download Now.
Choose 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads' (or pay what you want).
Download 'Christmas Pack - FBX models + texture' or the Unity package (35 MB each).

verdict.why: Timely, coherent holiday set with characters, vehicles and props on one atlas, free for commercial use, no generative AI. Minus: credit required, no rigs, source files paywalled.
